title: Valid Palindrome
statement: Given a string, return true if it is a palindrome after removing non-alphanumeric characters and ignoring case.

What is the brute force idea? Use extra loops or repeated checks.

What are the edge cases? Empty-like input, single values, duplicates, and boundaries.
What is the complexity? For most of these easy tasks, aim for O(n) time unless sorting is required.
